summary: Keith Brett, 29, fell 60-70 feet while simul-climbing the North Chimney on Longs Peak's East Face when a ledge broke beneath his feet (attempting Pervertical Sanctuary with his partner). His party lowered him to a bivy cave atop Mills Glacier; RMNP rangers provided medical care and he was flown by medical helicopter to Denver with a fractured wrist, two broken ribs and a punctured lung.
location: North Chimney, East Face, Longs Peak
notes: Date inferred: AAC 2012 annual (covers 2011 incidents) says 'Sunday August 28'; 2011-08-28 was a Sunday (verified). Fills thin year 2011 for Longs Peak.
